raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fixes #27231.

## Summary

- Preserve the request-level `background`, `use_audio_in_video`, and `routing_key` fields when `GenerateReqInput.__getitem__` creates a sub-request. `require_reasoning` was already forwarded on current main.
- Restate the original patch against the current implementation, which now includes `_sub_obj_cache` and the expanded IPC field set.
- Cover `n > 1` expansion, all four request-level fields, repeated indexed access returning the cached sub-object, and foreground requests remaining `False`.

Without this forwarding, Responses API background jobs can silently revert to foreground disconnect handling after request slicing.

## Test Plan

The new regression fails against the preceding implementation: `test_background_flag_survives_slicing` sees `background=False` in the sub-request. It passes with this change, alongside the foreground control.

Executed on macOS with Python 3.14.2, using the actual worktree import path:

```
PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest test/registered/unit/managers/test_io_struct.py -k background_flag -q
# pre-fix: 1 failed, 1 passed
# with fix: 2 passed

PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest test/registered/unit/managers/test_io_struct.py -q
# 67 passed, 2 skipped, 16 subtests passed

pre-commit run --files python/sglang/srt/managers/io_struct.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_io_struct.py
# Passed
```

`io_struct.py` was imported from the branch worktree during the tests. No GPU or multi-rank execution was needed for this request-slicing behavior; those lanes remain separate from the CPU result above.

Scope note for the Gemini review: this PR intentionally fixes only the background flag loss from #27231.

The other fields mentioned by the bot are covered separately so that each PR stays reviewable:
- require_reasoning and routing_key: #27199
- multimodal controls and mm_hashes: #27259
- session_params indexing: #27257

Keeping background isolated also matches the issue impact: Responses API background jobs can be aborted incorrectly when __getitem__ resets background to false.

Re-surfacing this one after some time. The background flag is still dropped when a request gets sliced, and the fix here preserves it with a regression test. I cannot add the run-ci label myself, so if a maintainer thinks this is worth landing, adding the label is all it needs from me.

Re-checked against current main today: `GenerateReqInput.__getitem__` still reconstructs the sub-request without `background` (the field exists on the class; it is just not forwarded in the slice), so a batch with `background=True` silently turns into foreground sub-requests and the responses API never sees the flag. The one-line forward plus the batch regression test still apply cleanly. Happy to rebase if a maintainer confirms the slice should forward it.

Re-verified on current main (93809202a3): `GenerateReqInput.__getitem__` still rebuilds the per-sample request field by field and `background` is still not among the copied fields, so an `n > 1` background batch still falls back to foreground disconnect handling on slice (#27231). Four months in the queue; could a maintainer add the run-ci label? The fix is one field plus a regression test.

{"body": "Current-main status check, since this branch is a few months old.

The bug is still live. On `upstream/main` at `582168dd7c`, `GenerateReqInput.background` is declared at `io_struct.py:325` and `__getitem__` does not forward it anywhere, so every per-sample sub-request produced for `n > 1` still comes out with the default `False` and runs as foreground.

What has changed since this branch: `__getitem__` was rewritten. It now caches sub-objects in `_sub_obj_cache` and forwards a couple of dozen more fields (`mm_hashes`, `mm_content_hashes`, `sampling_logprobs_mode`, `bootstrap_*`, `cache_salt`, `kv_hints`, and others). So the patch here no longer applies as written and needs restating against the new shape rather than rebasing. I have that restated locally against the current function, with the flag forwarded alongside `stream` and `log_metrics`, plus two regression cases in `test_io_struct.py` covering the `n > 1` slicing path and the sub-object cache.

I have not committed it yet and want to be explicit about why: my local sglang environment is currently unusable, so I cannot run the tests, and the repo requires a case to be observed failing before the fix and passing after it. I am not going to claim that from code reading. It goes up as soon as I can run it.

One thing worth settling first, since review time is the scarce thing here. This is being tracked three ways: this PR, #27466 which is now closed, and #37470 which is open against the same two files and is newer than this one. The reporter of #37470 already offered to close theirs rather than have three patches compete. If a maintainer has a preference I will follow it, including closing this one. My case for keeping it is the test: it pins the Responses API background semantics and the new sub-object cache, not only the field forwarding.

Related: issue #27231 was auto-closed by the stale bot on 2026-08-06 with reason COMPLETED, but the code was never changed, so the issue is still accurate. It may be worth reopening, or letting whichever PR lands carry it.
"}

@@ -1015,6 +1015,9 @@ def __getitem__(self, i):
             return_flat_raw_top_logprobs_b64=self.return_flat_raw_top_logprobs_b64,
             stream=self.stream,
             log_metrics=self.log_metrics,
+            background=self.background,
+            use_audio_in_video=self.use_audio_in_video,
+            routing_key=self.routing_key,
             return_hidden_states=(
                 self.return_hidden_states[i]

@@ -437,6 +437,40 @@ def setUp(self):
             rid=["id1", "id2"],
         )
 
+    def test_background_flag_survives_slicing(self):
+        """Every per-sample sub-request keeps the request-level `background` flag.
+
+        A dropped flag makes a Responses API background job run as foreground, so the
+        caller disconnecting aborts it.
+        """
+        req = copy.deepcopy(self.base_req)
+        req.sampling_params = [{"n": 3}, {"n": 3}]
+        req.background = True
+        req.require_reasoning = True
+        req.use_audio_in_video = True
+        req.routing_key = "test_key"
+        req.normalize_batch_and_arguments()
+
+        self.assertGreater(len(req.text), 2)
+        for i in range(len(req.rid)):
+            self.assertTrue(req[i].background)
+            self.assertTrue(req[i].require_reasoning)
+            self.assertTrue(req[i].use_audio_in_video)
+            self.assertEqual(req[i].routing_key, "test_key")
+
+        first = req[0]
+        self.assertIs(req[0], first)
+        self.assertTrue(first.background)
+
+    def test_background_flag_stays_false_for_foreground_requests(self):
+        req = copy.deepcopy(self.base_req)
+        req.sampling_params = [{"n": 2}, {"n": 2}]
+        req.background = False
+        req.normalize_batch_and_arguments()
+
+        for i in range(len(req.rid)):
+            self.assertFalse(req[i].background)
+
     def test_sampling_logprobs_mode_normalization(self):
         default_req = copy.deepcopy(self.base_req)
         default_req.normalize_batch_and_arguments()
